description: Offline Estonian and English speech-to-text (faster-whisper, CPU or NVIDIA GPU). Downloads about 3.5 GB once; uv, the libraries and the models are checked against SHA-256 hashes pinned in the repo.
post_install: if ($LASTEXITCODE) { abort 'Transcribe-Setup.exe failed (see above). Fix the network, then: scoop uninstall transcribe-offline; scoop install <this manifest URL>' }
